Convergence checkpoint — 2026-10-10 06:47 UTC

- PR #281 and #280 are integrated into `integration/community-release-20261008` at `35b32e76b3704dc47d856103ae62221c9a9f0789`. The tracked 30-PR cohort is 22 integrated, 8 blocked/open, 0 merge-ready at this observation. `community` is unchanged; no new Runtime publication.
- PR #273 now has a proper merge of that integration base at `73ea6797ff27bafdcc722242fd843272a99411ca`, tree `d3c36a4142c3cdaa69fd0872de551cfcdcca0024`. Four source lifecycle tests passed, including actual watched malformed-update/last-good/recovery/restart; independent production and test reviews passed, plus configured 311-file typecheck. Fresh hosted checks remain running and are required before admission.
- [Canonical ledger/handoff checkpoint](https://github.com/joshyorko/actions/commit/5eeb45b7d6c764063b81e6bbac6872add7af0f33) retains all 54 contracts and 16 historical ZIP hashes. Current issue stages: READY 0, ACTIVE 8, REVIEW 8, BLOCKED 28, INTEGRATED-but-unaccepted 9, COMPLETE 1. Supplemental #279 is separate. The old mixed-origin P0 baseline is explicitly corrected and preserved; it is not a full isolated baseline lifecycle proof.
- The accepted bounded Canvas producer criteria enable the existing #127 owner. Its local template checkpoint remains incomplete: unpublished Core API distribution, template/browser execution and authorized artifact resolution are separate gates. Independent review found one stale template-inventory assertion; the same owner is fixing it.
- CAS workers already have separate `/workspaces/actions-worktrees/<lane>` checkouts on target `cas-worker-01`; `/workspaces/cas-worker-01` remains the protected bootstrap checkout. At 06:45:24Z the same Devsy pod remained `Failed`, daemon unverified. Existing threads/worktrees are preserved; uncertain prior dispatch effects are not replayed. Cloud lanes and bounded diagnostics monitoring continue.

The full retained graph remains the mission. No migration actions, worker replacement swarm, parent-epic closure prerequisites, or release-gate waivers were introduced.
